title: docs(skills): objectstack-data carries the hosted build agent's metadata-authoring judgment (cloud#3659 A, port 1 of 3)
body:
Part of #31155 — card 1 of 4 of the objectstack-ai/cloud#3659 ruling-A split; this PR is the first per-domain port (objectstack-data). The automation and ui ports follow as their own PRs on the same card, so the card stays open.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:把云端私有搭建语料里「schema 表达不了的判断」搬进公开的 `objectstack-data` skill(布尔字段给默认值不设必填、人员字段用 `user` 且默认可选、动态默认值是保存时生效、状态用 select 不建表、审批/流水不建对象、负责人就是平台 `owner_id`、按需求选 `sharingModel`、状态机要声明 `initialStates`、汇总字段的限定词进 `filter`、迟声明的汇总用 `os migrate summary-nulls` 回填、种子值可虚构不可畸形且 `os validate` 先拒、标签跟随用户语言),外加 8 条 eval 用例;完整的 43+11 条规则映射表见 issue 评论与下文。
- 为什么改:cloud#3659 裁决 A ——所有搭建渠道只认发布的 skills + spec。本 PR 只搬第 3 类(判断),第 1 类(复述 spec)只映射到 spec 路径,第 2 类(运行时陷阱)列成 enforce-or-remove 清单交 spec 席(已立 #31224),不写散文。
- 风险与回滚:纯文档 + eval 夹具,无运行时改动;token 棘轮四行按实测钉住(ceiling 上调,裁决授权见脚本注释)。发布的 skill 正文全英文(审批人要求),eval 的提示语按裁决豁免。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`(Roll-up 段重写、五个示例的 `sharingModel`)、`skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`(Relationship Patterns 新增三行、Field Type Selection 三条、posture 段)、`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`(四行 ceiling 与注释)。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 预期全绿且 objectstack-data 四行 headroom 0。
- 需要你做的:Tier H 受管面(`skills/**`),需要你的 APPROVED review 后由席位落地;本 PR 保持 draft。

## What changes

**Language scope (approver os-zhuang, CHANGES_REQUESTED 2026-11-07T23:41Z, verbatim: 「skills 对外发布的版本应该全部用英文」; scope ruled by the account owner, verbatim 「同意」, to the seat's proposal):** every sentence a customer agent READS in the shipped skill text is English — the two example phrases in `SKILL.md` and the roll-up passage in `rules/relationships.md` were reworded to English or language-neutral wording teaching the same judgment, and every non-eval file this PR touches scans clean of CJK. Two exemptions: (a) eval prompt strings in `skills/**/evals/*.json` (they test "labels follow the user's language" and never enter an agent's context); (b) the existing `objectstack-i18n` Chinese example data, untouched.

`objectstack-data` gains the metadata-authoring judgment the hosted build agent carried privately and the published skill did not yet state — only **class 3** of the seat's triage (judgment the schema cannot express). Class 1 (restates the spec) is mapped to its spec path; class 2 (parses clean, dead at runtime) is listed as enforce-or-remove for the spec lane (filed as #31224); hosted-only and orchestration rules stay in cloud.

- `SKILL.md` § Object Definition — choose the `sharingModel` posture from the request (rule 16b); the skill's own examples now take that posture (below).
- `SKILL.md` § Field Type Selection — a yes/no flag is `{ type: 'boolean', defaultValue: false }`, never `required` (18); a person on the record is `type: 'user'`, optional unless asked (process-modeling); a dynamic default resolves on save, described as such (19d).
- `SKILL.md` § Relationship Patterns — three rows: status is a `select`, never a table (select-options); approvals / routing / audit trails are not objects (process-modeling); the owner is the platform `owner_id`, `ownership: 'none'` only for catalogs and junctions (16).
- `SKILL.md` § Validation Patterns — a `state_machine` declares `initialStates` whenever the status has a real start (17); the UPDATE-only mechanic sentence is not restated (the spec describe carries it).
- `rules/relationships.md` § Roll-up Summaries — the `filter` paragraph is rewritten: pick the function from the words, every qualifier goes in `filter` (dropped = a plausible wrong total), one child feeds several totals, a rate is a formula over a working summary; "The recompute runs only on a child write" — a summary declared after its rows exist is backfilled by `os migrate summary-nulls --apply` (`--recompute-undefined-on-empty OBJECT.FIELD` for one declared late), never by editing a child (15). Five example objects take the posture the SKILL.md paragraph teaches: `public_read_write` on `account`, `contact`, `invoice` and the `project_assignment` junction, `public_read` on the `category` table; the conditional-rules `invoice` in `SKILL.md` likewise.
- `rules/validation.md` § State Machine Validation — the canonical example declares `initialStates: ['draft']`, so it no longer undercuts the rule.
- `rules/naming.md` — Critical Rules 6: labels follow the user's language (21).
- `references/seeds.md` — "Fictional is fine; malformed is not", and `os validate` / `os build` refuse a malformed seed value first, at the record's field (19).
- Evals: `objects-fields-relationships.json` cases 10–14, `hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json` cases 14–16 (renumbered after the cases `main` landed, twice) — the equivalents of cloud's `boolean-never-required`, `label-language` and `people-lookups-optional` text pins, plus the roll-up qualifier, owner, status-select and sharing-posture teachings.
- `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` — four rows pinned AT the measurement (below).
- `.changeset/31155-port-authoring-rules-data.md` — `@objectstack/skills` patch.

Same-file pay-downs came first: in `SKILL.md` the `unique`-validation blockquote restated `rules/validation.md` § Uniqueness and is a one-line pointer now, and the `secret` / `user` parentheticals in Field Type Selection restated `rules/field-types.md` rows 42–43 and 96 and are gone; in `rules/relationships.md` the `engagement` example and the "aggregate only a subset" lead-in were restated by the kept `procurement_receipt` example, the `filter` code comment's second line is said by the paragraph, and the child-field half of the `filter` sentence left the prose (it is enforce-or-remove row #31224 D); in `rules/validation.md` the "(removed from the spec)" aside restated § Uniqueness.

Whole package, all `SKILL.md` summed: 4520 → 4549 (+29). Whole shipped tree under `skills/`: 20037 → 20217 (**+180 net lines**, inside the dispatch's +250 budget; evals are 120 of them).

## No-loss mapping table (private rule id → class → skills file and section → regression kept)

The v1 ledger is card comment 6711215678 on #31155; its deltas after the contract review are card comment 6711710289. This is the v2 table — both corpora, every rule:

Source corpus read at objectstack-ai/cloud `main` (2026-11-07): `packages/service-ai-studio/src/skills/metadata-authoring-skill.ts` (101,410 bytes, 43 rules), `solution-design-skill.ts` (52,885 bytes, 11 rules), `authoring-rule.ts` (19,183 bytes, the delivery machinery — no rules of its own). Every rule of both corpora is listed below; nothing is dropped from the ledger.

**Triage classes** (the seat's refinement of the card's item 1, on AGENTS.md contract-first and 「声明即强制」):
- **CLOUD** — orchestration or hosted-only (blueprint design, build loop, tool routing, confirm gate, drafts / NOT LIVE, plan tiers). Stays in cloud as the overlay (card item 2).
- **SPEC** — restates what `packages/spec` already defines or refuses. Not ported as prose; the spec path is the carrier. A `.describe()` that lacks the sentence an agent needs is listed as a *describe gap*.
- **E/R** — a trap that parses clean but is dead or wrong at runtime. Not written as prose; listed as *enforce-or-remove* for the spec lane.
- **STATED** — the published skill already states it; mapped to the existing text, no new prose.
- **PORT** — judgment the schema cannot express. Ported to the named skill and section. **PR 1 = this PR (objectstack-data)**; PR 2/3 = the later per-domain PRs on this card (automation, ui).

The "regression kept" column names the cloud pin that hardened the rule (tests under `packages/service-ai-studio/src/skills/__tests__/` and `__tests__/authoring-rules.test.ts`) and where its equivalent lives after the move. Spec paths are under `packages/spec/src/`.
